```sql
SELECT
  canal,
  ROUND(AVG(facturacion), 2) AS ticket_promedio
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.canal,
    SUM(i.cantidad * i.precio_unitario) AS facturacion
  FROM pedidos p
  JOIN items i ON p.pedido_id = i.pedido_id
  WHERE p.estado = 'entregado'
    AND p.fecha BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY p.pedido_id, p.canal
) AS pedidos_trimestre
GROUP BY canal;
```
